name: Monkman & Seagull's Genius Guide to Britain
original_name: Monkman & Seagull's Genius Guide to Britain
overview: University Challenge icons and real-life best friends Eric Monkman and Bobby Seagull are on a road trip with a difference. Feeding their insatiable appetite for knowledge, they visit Scotland, England, Northern Ireland and Wales in search of hidden gems of British scientific and technological ingenuity.
